messages:
Sam P: Kicking off the microphase rollout for r13 across regions. Plan is US warmup -> EU holdpoint -> APAC slowburn. Need capacity signoff + rollback triggers. Change window 02:00-05:00 UTC. Anyone on APAC hw oncall?

Deploy-bot: Deploy queued: r13 -> all zones. Starting US warmup slice 1 (5% traffic) at 3111112222. Canaries: /deploy status

Morgan R: noted. EU will be held at 10% for 15m. Current EU GPU headroom: 120 free slots (nv4x). If thermal >85C or queue depth >500, we'll pin back. Also watch disk i/o on cache nodes.

Oncall Ops: APAC has a known hot-pool (pool-apac-2) at 82% utilization. Recommend pre-warming 10 instances and bump warm-pool target +20%. If that fails, fallback model -> r12-quant.

Jin: Rollback criteria proposal: 1) 5m error rate increase >0.5pp 2) p95 latency >800ms for 5m 3) token error code 5xx >0.2%. If any two happen, auto-pin to previous version. Logging will tag with release=r13.

Ana: I'll run smoke tests once US canary is green. Tests: small chat thread + embeddings + long-context gen. Will post summary in 10m.

Deploy-bot: US warmup slice 1 successful. Latency p95 120ms, errors 0.01%. Prometheus link: https://prom.redwood/ops/dash/r13-canary

Sam P: Good. Morgan, Ana, Oncall Ops — please post EU and APAC preflight numbers and confirm the pin fallback path. Also update release notes with the KMS change and new quantization flags.

Morgan R: EU preflight: headroom 120 slots, cache hit ratio 93%, expected 12% increase latency under r13. Holding at 10% now.

Oncall Ops: APAC preflight: spun +10 warmers, pool now at 64% util, thermal steady. Pre-warm logs: https://logs.redwood/prewarm-3111112222

Ana: Smoke results: pass for chat/embeddings, long-context OK but memory jittered on one instance (OOM recovered). Marking as watch.

Jin: Updating rollback playbook: pin command -> /ops/pin r12 --grace 30s; manual runbook included. If auto-pin triggers, pg leads notified and traffic slice scaled down by 50%.

Deploy-bot: EU holdpoint complete. Advancing EU to slice 2 (30%) at +20m. APAC will proceed to slowburn 2% every 15m once EU slice2 stable.

Sam P: OK locking schedule. If any watch flags in next 45m escalate to oncall-sre. I'll update the release notes with region-by-region timings and rollback steps. Thanks. :thumbsup:
